Find More of What You Love

Tucked between the soft sands of the Atlantic and the peaceful charm of South Carolina’s waterways, North Myrtle Beach invites you to slow down, soak it in, and rediscover the simple joys you love most. Come see why so many return here year after year and maybe even find a new favorite along the way.

Discover the Best of North Myrtle Beach

Whether you're seeking a peaceful escape or an action-packed adventure, North Myrtle Beach offers the perfect blend of relaxation and excitement. Enjoy family-friendly attractions, savor fresh seafood and dive into on-the-water fun.
